metric.name: heap_growth_objects_by_class
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.memory.heap_graph.heap_graph_class_aggregation;
SELECT sum(value) AS value FROM (
SELECT type_name AS key, SUM(reachable_obj_count) AS value
FROM android_heap_graph_class_aggregation
WHERE graph_sample_ts = (
  SELECT MAX(graph_sample_ts) FROM android_heap_graph_class_aggregation
)
GROUP BY type_name
HAVING value > 0
ORDER BY key

)

claims.text: Reachable heap objects increased from 432751 in the baseline to 434935 in the current trace, a delta of 2184 objects.

claims.text: Commit 6efb841e removed the synchronized cleanup that removed and cleared wrapped listeners inside resetForReuse, directly matching the observed growth in listener-related objects.

caveats: This is a single capture per side, so the magnitude should be confirmed with repeated runs.
The heap metric reports reachable objects from heap-graph snapshots; it does not by itself prove that every additional object is permanently leaked.
